sloka: मृष्टम् अन्नम् उपानीतम् अश्नाति न हि तम् विना ।यदा हि हयम् आरूढो मृगयाम् याति राघवः ॥१-१८-३१॥
transliteration: mṛṣṭam annam upānītam aśnāti na hi tam vinā ।yadā hi hayam ārūḍho mṛgayām yāti rāghavaḥ ॥1-18-31॥

translations.english: In a similar manner Satrughna, younger brother of Lakshmana, became dearer than his own life to Bharata. Similarly, Bharata also was dear to Satrughna.
